title: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 경기도 안양시와 광명시의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Gwangmyeong-si, Gyeonggi-do) (1) The following parcels of land in Seoksu-dong, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Gwangmyeong-si, Gyeonggi-do: Lot 576-12, Lot 576-13, Lot 862-3, Lot 863, and Lots 863-5 through 863-7.
(2) The following parcels of land in Bakdal-dong, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Gwangmyeong-si, Gyeonggi-do: Lot 655-3, Lot 864-183, Lot 864-184, Lot 865, and Lot 865-8.
